name: Wheat
source: Illustrative ICAR / FAO Wheat Phenology Framework

stages.name: Sowing & Emergence
stages.description: Seeds germinate and seedlings emerge above the ground. Radical roots develop.

stages.name: Crown Root Initiation (CRI)
stages.description: Crown roots begin developing 2-3 cm below the soil surface. Extremely sensitive to soil moisture deficit.
stages.source: Illustrative ICAR CRI Irrigation Window Manual

stages.name: Tillering
stages.description: Lateral shoots (tillers) emerge from the crown, determining final spike potential. Sensitive to waterlogging.

stages.name: Jointing & Booting
stages.description: Stem elongation begins and head swells inside the flag leaf sheath.

stages.name: Flowering / Anthesis
stages.description: Anthers emerge and pollination occurs. Most sensitive stage: rain washes pollen, heat causes floret sterility.
stages.source: Illustrative ICAR / CIMMYT Anthesis Vulnerability Tables

stages.name: Grain Filling (Milk & Dough)
stages.description: Kernel expands and accumulates starches. Terminal heat causes premature drying and shriveling.

stages.name: Maturity & Harvest
stages.description: Grain hardens and moisture drops below 14%. Rain causes pre-harvest sprouting, lodging, and black point fungus.
